PARAGRAPH 1
THE SENTENCE CLAIMS THAT ONE OUGHT TO DISOBEY A LAW DEEMED BAD, BUT THIS PRESENTS A FALSE DICHOTOMY BETWEEN MORAL JUDGMENT AND LEGAL OBLIGATION, IGNORING THE POSSIBILITY OF WORKING THROUGH LEGAL CHANNELS TO AMEND UNJUST LAWS.

PARAGRAPH 2
